column1: # Issue #144 item 3: the closed roster of public lane kernels and how each is disposed of.
# this file and that roster differ in either direction, so a new kernel family is uncertified until
# it is registered here and given a rule per backend in vectorization-allowlist.tsv.

column5: mask constructor with no input and no floating-point operation; the lane shape it produces is certified where it is consumed (builtins-gain-mute, builtins-zero-lanes)
mask constructor from a frame count; integer compare only, no floating-point operation
mask constructor from a control-plane flag slice; read once per block off the sample loop
mask constructor with no input and no floating-point operation; see mask-all-lanes
the whole-lane store of one history row; LLVM expresses it as a 32-byte memcpy rather than a typed vector store, so its IR class is no-float and the width is certified in the object
slice-index helper returning a borrowed row; performs no arithmetic and emits no floating-point instruction
